title: Akkadian literary predictive texts ('prophecies'): Dynastic Prophecy (BM 40623), Uruk, Marduk, Šulgi Prophecies, Text A / Аккадские «пророчества», «Династическое пророчество»
author: Anonymous
date: 12th c. BCE (Marduk) to early Hellenistic (Dynastic Prophecy, after 331 BCE)
edition: Grayson, Babylonian Historical-Literary Texts (1975); Neujahr, Predicting the Past (2012). Both copyrighted.
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia full-text search for 'Династическое пророчество' gives 1 hit (a mention in 'Набонид'); CyberLeninka shows no translation.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia lists the Dynastic and Uruk Prophecies among Akkadian literature; standard English editions are Grayson 1975 and Neujahr 2012 (not re-verified online).
value: Babylonian ex eventu view of the fall of Darius III and of Alexander. Background for Daniel, the Oracle of the Potter, the Demotic Chronicle and prophecy motifs in the Alexander Romance. Small and high-impact.
ai_feasibility: high: short and heavily studied. The contested restorations (Alexander/Darius passage) are an ideal showcase for visible disagreement between models.
pilot_unit: Dynastic Prophecy complete (one 4-column tablet) + Uruk Prophecy
